g.text: Two-Tier Gateway Topology • Strict Bounded Contexts • gRPC HTTP/2 Backplane • Database-per-Service
Spring Cloud Gateway (Netty Reactor) • Edge Security • OAuth2/JWT Validation • Global Rate Limiting • DDoS Shield • Geo-Routing
DOWNWARD DEPENDENCY ONLY • AGNOSTIC TO ALL PRODUCT WORKFLOWS
Strict Isolation Policy: No cross-service database queries • All state extraction via typed gRPC stubs • Zero circular dependencies
